title: Check: network and storage faults
description: Five questions on isolating where traffic or a mount is going wrong.

questions.prompt: A Service is unreachable. What is the most useful first check?

options.text: Whether the Service has ready endpoints

questions.explanation: No endpoints means the fault is the selector or Pod readiness, not the network. It splits the problem in half immediately.

questions.prompt: Traffic works to the Pod IP but not to the Service VIP, from one node only. Which component?
questions.explanation: Pod IP reachability proves the CNI is fine. Service VIPs are kube-proxy's programming, and it is per node.

questions.prompt: A Pod is stuck in ContainerCreating with a volume mount error. Where is the message?

options.text: `kubectl describe pod` events, and the kubelet journal on that node

questions.explanation: There are no container logs yet - the container never started. The kubelet is the component doing the mounting.

questions.prompt: A Pod is Pending with 'Multi-Attach error for volume'. What does that mean?

options.text: A ReadWriteOnce volume is still attached to another node

questions.explanation: Usually an old Pod on a different node has not fully terminated. RWO is a per-node exclusive lock.

questions.prompt: Write a command that starts a temporary interactive shell Pod for network debugging using image nicolaka/netshoot.
questions.explanation: A throwaway Pod inside the cluster network is the fastest way to test DNS and connectivity from where it matters.
